organization.name_en: Nippon Medical School Musashi Kosugi Hospital

affected.note: Outpatients and inpatients, per the 5th report (2026-02-27); the first report had cited about 10,000. About 1,700 staff and clinical-training medical students since 2021 were also affected. Medical records, card data and My Number card data were not confirmed leaked.

summary.en: Nippon Medical School Musashi Kosugi Hospital said servers of its nurse call system were hit by ransomware on 2026-02-09 through a VPN device used for medical equipment maintenance, and that patient data was stolen. It later put the leak at about 130,000 patients' names, addresses, phone numbers, birthdates and patient IDs.
summary.ja: 日本医科大学武蔵小杉病院は、2026年2月9日に医療機器保守用VPN装置を経由してナースコールシステムのサーバーがランサムウェア攻撃を受け、患者の個人情報が窃取されたと発表した。その後、漏えい対象は約13万人分の氏名、住所、電話番号、生年月日、患者IDなどとした。
